description:
Your prompt vocabulary, one hotkey away, in every window

A tray app for Windows that keeps your prompt library one hotkey away. Press the hotkey in any window, pick a prompt, and it is pasted where you were, with the clipboard already substituted for {clipboard}. Prompts live as plain JSON under %APPDATA%; packs are files you can share or let an agent write. No telemetry. One update check, off in a click.
A new install now starts with Windows, a paste into an administrator window says why it didn't land, and the manager no longer holds memory while it's closed. Builds on v0.2.29.
Starting with Windows
- A fresh install starts with Windows. Until now nothing turned this on, so after the first restart the hotkey did nothing until you opened Promptline again. The first launch of a new install from the setup exe (winget and Scoop use it too) turns it on once, and the welcome banner says so, with a Don't button. If Windows' Startup page already has Promptline off, that stays. The MSI leaves it off.
- Upgrades are untouched. If you already have Promptline, this release doesn't change your Start with Windows setting.
- On new installs, the update check now runs from sign-in. It is the same check to the same address, at startup and once a day, still switchable under Settings → About; it now also happens on days you didn't open the app yourself.
Pasting
- An administrator window says so instead of eating the prompt. Windows silently drops keystrokes sent to a program running as administrator, so a paste into an elevated terminal used to close the popup and land nothing. Promptline now checks first, and the popup comes back with "That window runs as administrator" and the text ready for a Ctrl+V by hand. Run Promptline as administrator too and it pastes there as usual.
- To check, Promptline now looks up the target window's privilege level before each paste. It asks Windows only for that one fact about the program, nothing is sent anywhere, and it's the first time the app looks at another process at all.
Popup
- Right-click a row for its actions. The action panel used to open only on Tab, always for the selected row, so pointing at a row and pressing Tab gave the actions of another one. A right-click now opens the panel for the row under the pointer and selects it, without pasting. Tab still means the selected row.
Manager
- The manager window is built when you open it, and let go five minutes after you close it. If you only ever use the hotkey, Promptline now runs with one browser engine instead of two, about 40 MB less from sign-in. Reopening within five minutes brings back the window as you left it; after that, it opens fresh, as after a restart.
Install
Promptline_0.2.30_x64-setup.exe (NSIS) or Promptline_0.2.30_x64_en-US.msi.
Signed, so Windows names the publisher. SmartScreen can still warn while a
new release builds its reputation: More info → Run anyway.
Your prompts, packs and settings carry over untouched.
